title: Enchanting
description: Every effect you can learn by disenchanting, plus unique artifact enchantments: where to get them and whether they work on followers.

items.title: Absorb Health
items.description: Drains the target's Health and gives it to you.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Weapons (swords, axes, bows, etc.; not staves)

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Blade of Woe — Astrid's dagger: pickpocket it, take it if you kill her, or receive it at the end of Death Incarnate (Dark Brotherhood).

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Works: per UESP, weapon enchantments work normally for followers.

items.title: Absorb Magicka
items.description: Drains the target's Magicka and gives it to you.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Weapons (swords, axes, bows, etc.; not staves)

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Any enchanted weapon with this effect — common loot and blacksmith stock.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Works: per UESP, weapon enchantments work normally for followers.

tips: The Drainspell Bow from Labyrinthian has a separate version of the effect: learn both to apply Absorb Magicka twice.

items.title: Soul Trap
items.description: If the target dies within the duration, its soul fills a soul gem.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Weapons (swords, axes, bows, etc.; not staves)

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Any enchanted weapon with this effect — common loot and blacksmith stock.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Works: per UESP, weapon enchantments work normally for followers.

tips: Set the duration to 1–2 seconds: you hit often, and the charges last much longer.

items.title: Fiery Soul Trap
items.description: Soul traps the target and burns it at the same time.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Weapons (swords, axes, bows, etc.; not staves)

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls — the only source: behind the warlord's throne in Ironbind Barrow (Winterhold Hold).

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Works: per UESP, weapon enchantments work normally for followers. Per UESP, one trapped soul may fill all of the follower's gems of that type.

tips: The fire damage is fixed; use the minimum trap duration for a huge number of charges.

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Lunar swords, maces and war axes — in Silent Moons Camp (by the Lunar Forge).

facts.label: On a follower

tips: Bug: on items you enchant yourself the effect works at any time of day.

items.title: Smithing Expertise
items.description: Raises Smithing while wielded and deals shock damage on hit.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Weapons (swords, axes, bows, etc.; not staves)

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Notched Pickaxe — the only source: stuck in the summit of the Throat of the World. With the Unofficial Patch (USKP) it cannot be disenchanted.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Partly: the shock damage works like any weapon enchantment, but the Smithing bonus is useless to a follower. UESP has no specific test.

items.title: Fortify Alchemy
items.description: Potions and poisons you brew are stronger.

facts.label: Can be applied to
facts.value: Head, hands, ring, amulet

facts.label: How to learn
facts.value: Muiri's Ring — Muiri's reward for Mourning Never Comes (Dark Brotherhood); also helmets, bracers and necklaces of Alchemy sold by merchants.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Does not work: not on the UESP list, and all other apparel enchantments have no effect on followers.

tips: A four-piece Alchemy set is the basis of the alchemy-enchanting loop for the strongest items.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: Auriel's Bow.

items.title: Ebony Mail
items.description: Muffles your steps and surrounds you with a poison cloak that damages nearby enemies.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: The cuirass Ebony Mail.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: Boethiah's reward for Boethiah's Calling.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Partly: Muffle works on followers, but UESP has no clear data on the poison cloak.

items.title: Ring of Namira
items.description: Gives +50 Stamina and lets you feed on corpses for bonus Health and Health regen.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: Ring of Namira.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: Namira's reward for The Taste of Death.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Partly: the Stamina bonus works (it is on the UESP list), but feeding on corpses is only available to the player.

items.title: Spellbreaker
items.description: While blocking, creates a ward that absorbs up to 50 points of spell damage.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: The shield Spellbreaker.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: Peryite's reward for The Only Cure.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Does not work per the general UESP rule: apparel enchantments not on the list have no effect on followers. No specific test for the shield.

items.title: Konahrik
items.description: At low health may heal you, knock back and burn nearby enemies, and sometimes summon a spectral dragon priest.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: The dragon priest mask Konahrik.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: Collect the eight base-game dragon priest masks and place them in Bromjunaar Sanctuary.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Does not work per the general UESP rule: apparel enchantments not on the list have no effect on followers. No specific test for the mask.

items.title: Amulet of Talos
items.description: Reduces the time between shouts by 20%.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: The Amulet of Talos and its named variants; divine amulets cannot be disenchanted.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: Random loot and clothing merchant stock; often carried by guards and Talos worshippers.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Does not work: not on the UESP list, and followers do not use shouts.

items.title: Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking
items.description: Let you walk on water; with any four Relics of Ahzidal they give +10 Enchanting.

facts.label: Item
facts.value: Ahzidal's Boots of Waterwalking — the only item with Waterwalking.

facts.label: How to get
facts.value: In Kolbjorn Barrow, during Unearthed.

facts.label: On a follower
facts.value: Works: Waterwalking is on the UESP list of effects that work on followers.
